question: Should `operator.read` health responses surface redacted runtime-config drift path names and perform a fresh disk config snapshot comparison on cache hits?
rationale: The patch is additive and tested, but auth-adjacent health visibility and per-health freshness cost are product and operations tradeoffs that CI cannot settle.

options.title: Accept Diagnostic Boundary
options.body: Land this PR after exact-head CI because raw values, fingerprints, and detailed disk errors stay admin-gated while operators get timely drift state.

options.title: Request Privacy Or Latency Proof
options.body: Ask for one more read-vs-admin transcript or latency sample if maintainers are not comfortable with drift path visibility or per-cache-hit disk reads.

options.title: Pause For Companion Policy PR
options.body: Hold this PR only if maintainers decide diagnostics and the hot-mode restart-policy PR #89517 must land as one reviewed package.

recommendation.title: Accept Diagnostic Boundary
recommendation.body: Land this PR after exact-head CI because raw values, fingerprints, and detailed disk errors stay admin-gated while operators get timely drift state.
